title: cytisus hirsutus subsp. hirsutissimus
intro: Cytisus hirsutus subsp. hirsutissimus, commonly known as Scotch broom or Italian broom, is a shrub-like perennial plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus hirsutus subsp. hirsutissimus include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and act as an antispasmodic, making it useful for treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
